subject: Money
title: Investment Banking
description: A fast breakdown of Investment Banking for builders.

hook.text: Goldman Sachs earned $46 billion in 2023. Not from checking accounts, but from deals most people never see.

buildup.text: Investment banks arrange mergers, underwrite stock offerings, and trade securities. Different world from retail.

discovery.text: When a company goes public, the investment bank buys all shares first, then sells them to the public at a markup.

twist.text: Glass-Steagall separated commercial and investment banking in 1933. Its repeal in 1999 helped cause 2008.

climax.text: Investment banks trade risk for profit at scale. When they win, they earn billions. When they lose, you bail them out.
